description_en: Moves a target instance to a target resource group
description_zh: 调用MoveResourceGroup将目标实例移动至目标资源组
kebab_example: aliyun hbase move-resource-group --cluster-id ld-bp169l540vc6c0000 --new-resource-group-id rg-aekzrk6zzsy0000 --api-version 2019-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: MoveResourceGroup

parameters.description_en: The ID of the target instance. You can call the [DescribeInstances](~~144595~~) operation to obtain the instance ID.
parameters.help_en: The ID of the target instance. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/144595.html operation to obtain the instance ID
parameters.name: cluster_id

parameters.description_en: The ID of the target resource group. You can call the [ListResourceGroups](~~158855~~) operation to query the list of resource groups.
parameters.description_zh: 目标资源组ID，可调用[ListResourceGroups](~~158855~~)接口查看资源组列表。
parameters.help_en: The ID of the target resource group. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/158855.html operation to query the list of resource groups
parameters.help_zh: 目标资源组ID，可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/158855.html接口查看资源组列表
parameters.name: new_resource_group_id
